ideas.pitch: A mobile and web platform for rural local bodies to track community water assets, maintenance logs, and fund utilization under national missions.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing UN SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation) by helping local communities manage rural water supply infrastructure efficiently.
ideas.title: JalSetu Rural Water & Asset Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven success pattern of JalSetu at SIH 2024, directly targeting rural administration pain points appreciated by UN-affiliated judges.

ideas.pitch: A community-level waste collection optimizer and recycling tracker connecting households directly with local waste pickers and municipal recyclers.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing UN SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities) through decentralized waste mismanagement reduction.
ideas.title: EcoSaathi Neighborhood Waste Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the winning formula of WasteX and TrashMaster with a localized ledger approach, providing clear measurable environmental metrics for judges.

ideas.pitch: A citizen-reporting mobile web tool for identifying, geotagging, and reporting dangerous rural road hazards and missing safety signs.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing UN SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being) by mitigating accident risks on underserved rural roadways.
ideas.title: MargRaksha Rural Road Safety Audit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on the MargRaksha-2026 winning strategy, appealing heavily to nation-building initiatives and government-focused panels.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight mobile scanner that instantly identifies household product packaging barcodes and provides hyper-local disposal instructions based on municipal waste facilities.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing UN SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production) by simplifying household recycling habits.
ideas.title: GreenBarcode Local Recycling Guide
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact Best Hack winning strategy of garbage-scan by providing an instantly demonstrable, functional camera feature within a 24-hour window.

ideas.pitch: A GIS-enabled platform allowing community organizers to map grassroots sustainability projects, verify volunteer hours, and export compliance reports for UN body reviews.
ideas.problem_statement: Addressing UN SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals) by providing verifiable execution metrics for student-led social ventures.
ideas.title: CivicPulse Local Impact Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the live-dashboard and impact-metrics winning pattern from catwalk, directly satisfying the requirement for independently verifiable projects.
